title: Psalm 73 (Whom Have I in Heaven?)
lyrics_original: My flesh and my heart faileth
And God is my portion forever

bible_verses.english: Whom have I in heaven but you? I desire no one on earth besides you.
God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.

Yes, most certainly, I count all things to be loss for the excellence of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them to be rubbish, that I may gain Christ

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, when my strength runs out and my heart feels fragile, remind me that You are my eternal portion. Search my heart today and sweep away the distractions that compete for my affection. There is truly no one in heaven or on earth who compares to Your goodness and love. Be my ultimate desire and the steady anchor of my soul, now and forever. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Life often brings moments where our physical strength and heart seem to fail, leaving us feeling weak and uncertain. Yet, this song gently reminds us that God remains our ultimate treasure, surpassing every earthly pursuit and desire. When everything else fades, Jesus stands as the one who truly satisfies our souls and holds us secure. Today, let us open our hands, letting go of temporary comforts to anchor our joy fully in His abiding presence.
